split: Sort datasets by SHA-256 of the name, then assign round-robin to four folds. All reference labels in a held-out fold are excluded from rank-model fitting.
priority: Signed difference in predicted hits between the two exclusive sets, divided by the total number of exclusive records.
budget: Within each held-out fold, match the sum of baseline audit counts over eligible panels. Give every eligible panel up to 5% of its original cap, then fill the remaining budget up to 25% of each cap. Compare descending priority and a smooth allocation with extra-check weights proportional to baseline checks times exp(8 times priority). Apply the same exact test as the baseline. Budget independently for the primary and available second-reference cohorts. This is a pooled diagnostic budget over separate review decisions.
zero_sign_screen: Use the same held-out rank score for a single-panel gate. Audit at the unchanged baseline per-panel limit if the predicted signed gap is positive. Otherwise do not audit. Zero is the endpoint boundary. Report actual check savings and any certificates forgone.
report: Actual checks, detection probabilities, material-panel counts, worst-case null control, and differences by held-out target.
